question: Which of the following books is an autobiography of the Indian constitutional jurist Fali S Nariman?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Before Memory Fades: An Autobiography.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fali Sam Nariman** (born 10 January 1929) is an Indian jurist.
 
• He is the** senior advocate to the ****Supreme Court of India since 1971 and was the President of the Bar Association of India from 1991 to 2010.**
 
• Nariman is an** internationally recognised jurist** in international arbitration.
 
• Nariman's autobiography is called **"Before Memory Fades".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **​A**utobiography is **the biography of oneself narrated by oneself**.** ** 
 
• In her autobiography, **Courage and Commitment**, Ms. Alva put the blame on senior leader A.K. Antony for her** removal from ****organisational positions and held that it was because she had once recommended his [Mr. Antony] removal as the Kerala Chief minister earlier.**** **
